name: together
description: Together V1 — Amaya Bay, a persistent multiplayer cozy life simulator

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @together/shared build && concurrently -n client,server -c auto "pnpm --filter @together/client dev" "pnpm --filter @together/server dev"
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @together/shared build && pnpm --filter @together/content build && pnpm -r --if-present test && pnpm verify:pure
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm validate && pnpm validate:repo && pnpm build
